studies.locator: Experimental Section 4.2 Instruments; 4.3 Synthesis of the HAp@CNF Nanocomposite; 4.4 electrode preparation
studies.claim: Electrospinning a hydroxyapatite/PAN precursor followed by nitrogen-atmosphere carbonization produces hydroxyapatite-containing carbon nanofibers. The BTF-1200C vacuum tube furnace is expressly named. Further preparation incorporates myoglobin and Nafion into an electrode coating. The electrospinner is not identified by make/model.
studies.scope: P11 is the broad thermal-conversion route. Do not label this as the same protocol as P20: HAp-loaded PAN carbonization differs from nanocarbon-loaded polymer-mat electrospinning. Hydroxyapatite is a phosphate; do not mislabel it as a metal oxide.

studies.claim: A segmented-flow platform produces cesium lead halide nanocrystals while recording fluorescence. CETONI neMESYS syringe pumps feed precursor and carrier streams to a PEEK cross. reference.title: Inflating hollow nanocrystals through a repeated Kirkendall cavitation process
reference.notes: Cited by Gao2022 reference39. Methods report repeated phosphorus insertion/extraction for hollow Pd nanocrystals. No manufacturing equipment maker/model named. Sonication modality unspecified, so no bath or probe-model identity inferred. Characterization and electrocatalysis tests remain separate from manufacture.

studies.locator: Methods / Synthesis of Pd nanocubes; Methods / Synthesis of hollow Pd nanocrystals
studies.claim: Repeated phosphorus insertion and oxidative extraction converts Pd seed nanocrystals to hollow Pd nanoshells. The authors describe heated magnetic stirring, centrifugation/washing and unspecified sonication. Repeating the conversion enlarges voids and thins shells. Atmosphere and temperature alter the observed morphology; this is a reported study result, not an app prediction.
output: Hollow monometallic Pd nanocrystals / nanoshells; successive H-Pd-1, H-Pd-2 and H-Pd-3 study samples
studies.scope: No named manufacturing maker/model; do not create a commercial instrument identity. Sonication does not resolve probe versus bath; do not claim either exact model. Three-neck flask and nitrogen flow do not independently establish a Schlenk manifold. Named TEM, XRD, ICP-MS and electrochemical apparatus are characterization/catalytic testing, separate from manufacture. One published source used two atomistic and experimental analyses; not independent validation of app predictions.
